sections.title: The Intuitive Hook: The Smoothie Analogy (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: A smoothie is just combined ingredients.
Signals are just combined sine waves.
Decompose them to find the ingredients.
animations: Fade in a blender icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blender.svg] #FFFFFF at center.

Display ingredients (vector arrows) in #FF5733 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fruit.svg], #33FF57 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vegetable.svg], and #3357FF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ice.svg] around the blender.
Animate ingredients merging into the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blender.svg] center.

sections.title: Prerequisite Recap: Rotating Vectors (0:45-1:30)
lecture_lines: Euler's formula connects circles and sine.
A vector rotating creates a wave.
animations: Display two basis vectors i-hat #FFFF00 and j-hat #00FFFF, positioned relative to a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Rotate i-hat and j-hat by 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
Highlight the path traced by the rotation using light gray #AAAAAA arcs, referencing the orientation of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].

sections.title: The Mechanism: The Center of Mass (1:30-3:00)
lecture_lines: Wrap a signal around a circle.
Adjust frequency to match the signal.
The Fourier transform acts as prism.
animations: Place a set of points (masses) #FFFFFF in a 2D plane using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg] as a visual marker.
Calculate and draw the centroid (center of mass) in #FF00FF.
Move the points and show the centroid reacting in real-time, with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg] icons updating their positions dynamically.

sections.title: Key Concept: Time Domain vs. Frequency Domain (3:00-4:00)
lecture_lines: Time domain shows how things happen.
Frequency domain shows what things are.
Fourier transform bridges these two views.
animations: Display time-domain and frequency-domain plots side-by-side.

sections.title: Application: Real-World Filtering (4:00-5:00)
lecture_lines: Unwanted noise has unique high frequencies.
Remove these to clear your audio.
animations: Render a noisy signal #FF0000 on a graph, originating from a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microphone.svg].
Apply a low-pass filter (represented by a shaded block) #FFFFFF.
Display the cleaned signal #00FF00 output on a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].
